# Email orders now go straight to the order sheet

Preview: From Monday, email purchase orders reach the order sheet without retyping.

Purchase orders that arrive by email now come first; phone orders stay on the order sheet for now.

The day's orders will reach the bookkeeping system as invoices without retyping.

## What to do

Keep taking phone orders on the order sheet as before, and tell the operations manager by Friday if an email order looks wrong.

Sources: The owner's decision on email orders, Larkspur Ceramics, 13 October 2026; The plan's new process, Larkspur Ceramics, 15 October 2026.
